spells.name: Gleaming Quill
spells.description: Rakan flings a magical feather that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the feather hits a champion or epic jungle monster, Rakan restores Health to himself and nearby allies after seconds or when he touches an allied champion.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Grand Entrance
spells.description: Rakan dashes, then spirals into the air, Knocking Up for second and dealing magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Battle Dance
spells.description: Rakan dashes to an allied champion, granting them Shield for seconds. Rakan can Recast this Ability once within seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: The Quickness
spells.description: Rakan gains % Move Speed for seconds. Rakan deals magic damage and Charms enemies for second(s) the first time he touches them. The first champion touched grants Rakan % decaying Move Speed.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamageTooltip was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
